scenes.title: A boat from Sela
scenes.summary: The party meets Sela Thorn, a tide-reader mending nets, who will row them out but never at night; hers is the only boat that goes near the bell water. She says Saltmere flooded the night the bell first rang forty years ago, and the water came up warm. She'll wait at pier four at first light.

scenes.title: The flooded Saltmere Mine
scenes.place: Saltmere Mine, up the cliff path
scenes.summary: The mine entrance breathes warm air smelling of church candle wax; the tunnel is flooded with warm black water and hymn-book pages. A page is pencilled 'M. Brand', which Teo recognizes as his sister Mira's handwriting. Vessa and Oren theorize that harbor-master Maren is in the cult.

scenes.title: Midnight at the drowned chapel
scenes.place: Shore below the old chapel ruins
scenes.summary: Fishermen warn the party off the water, citing the Kelp Mother who pulls children down. At midnight the bell rings twelve times under the water, the humming is much louder than two nights ago (choir clock at three of six), and pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor before vanishing. The party flees.

scenes.title: Stew and a plan at the Tarred Gull
scenes.place: The Tarred Gull, tavern by the docks
scenes.summary: The party decides, since Mira wrote in the hymn book, to dive to the chapel at low tide by day, with Sela rowing at first light. Innkeeper Bram says he has known Maren thirty years and that she lost a brother to the bay. They take a long rest at the inn.
